current.text: He signed with Boston on a minimum contract as veteran point guard help.
He comes off the bench behind Derrick White and Payton Pritchard. Boston is very deep, with at least 12 rotation-level players, so in a 10-man rotation someone misses out most nights.
The newest preview has him as the 10th man in the rotation. He can play the backup point guard role, which may cut into Pritchard's work as a bench ball handler.
Experts do not expect much fantasy production from him this season.

durable.text: Points and rebounds are his weakest categories. Both are far below the top 250 pool.
He shoots about 90% from the line. He gets to the line so rarely that it barely moves a team's FT%.

note: He is not a draft target in our league. Both sites rank him around 300 and value him at 0 USD, far outside the 144 players we draft, and his projections (about 4 points and 2.6 assists in under 18 minutes) give little beyond a small edge in turnovers. Only watch him early in the season if White or Pritchard miss time and his minutes clearly go up.
